card.situation:
Full-service janitorial services at Culebra National Wildlife Refuge, Puerto Rico — two cleaning zones, all labor/materials/equipment furnished by contractor, 1 base year + four option years, Total Small Business Set-Aside, Best Value/Trade-Off evaluation.
Reached the owner because NAICS 561720 is an exact match, the firm is SBA/WOSB-eligible for the set-aside, and the fit score of 0.62 cleared the routing threshold — but a hard owner rule flags the 2,400-mile distance to Puerto Rico.
reasons_for: NAICS 561720 exact match and WOSB/SBA eligibility satisfy the set-aside and size-standard requirements outright [605b8074-a153fa6d-p2-976f7fc9].
Firm holds three qualifying federal past-performance references (GSA Region 7, VA Oklahoma City, Oklahoma OMES) sufficient to complete the mandatory references form [605b8074-296adf5d-p1-af197376].

CIMS-GB certification, CMMS-logged QC program, and green cleaning program directly meet the quality control, QASP-readiness, and environmentally compliant supplies requirements [605b8074-a8166aa3-p1-f300addc].
reasons_against: Place of performance is Culebra NWR, Puerto Rico — approximately 2,400 miles from Oklahoma City — triggering the hard owner 200-mile bid limit with no Caribbean or Puerto Rico presence documented [605b8074-a8166aa3-p2-594a3ab5].

Firm has no documented logistics capability to transport equipment, supplies, or personnel to a remote island location, leaving transportation and materials-supply requirements as confirmed gaps [605b8074-a153fa6d-p1-c5c19021].

No Puerto Rico-based workforce or background-cleared substitute pool exists, making the 98%-compliance attendance standard and uninterrupted-workforce requirement undemonstrable under best-value evaluation [605b8074-a8166aa3-p9-f6ed9832].

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services — Capability Statement
Submitted in Response to: PR-CULEBRA NWR-JANITORIAL SERVICES
SAM.gov Notice ID: 605b807449df46beac3adb1e03ed4bd3

Red Cedar Facility Services is a WOSB/EDWOSB and SBA-certified small business operating under NAICS 561720 (Janitorial Services), well within the $22M size standard. We provide full-service janitorial and custodial solutions for federal and state clients, furnishing all labor, supervision, equipment, materials, consumables, paper products, and trash liners required to maintain clean, hygienic, and safe environments.

Our quality program is anchored by CIMS-GB certification and a CMMS-based inspection platform that logs every QC event, supports QASP reporting, and drives continuous improvement. All supervisors hold OSHA 30 credentials. Our green cleaning program uses environmentally compliant products consistent with EPA Safer Choice, Green Seal, and GSA environmental procurement standards, directly meeting the solicitation's chemical-approval requirements.

Our 38 W-2 employees provide workforce depth that supports uninterrupted performance and rapid substitution of background-cleared personnel. We have successfully delivered custodial services on federal property managed by GSA Region 7, the Department of Veterans Affairs, and the Oklahoma Office of Management and Enterprise Services, with documented past performance available for all three references.

We are enrolled in e-Verify and maintain a compliance infrastructure — including FAR representations and certifications — consistent with federal contracting requirements.

Point of Contact:
Red Cedar Facility Services
